points: \item Architected and implemented intelligent AI Copilot systems for electronic design automation (EDA), utilizing large language models to streamline complex hardware design flows.
\item Developed agentic workflows using LangChain to automate intricate engineering tasks, significantly reducing the time-to-market for FPGA designs.
\item Engineered high-performance software stacks spanning firmware, drivers, and frameworks to enable and optimize AI workloads on Altera hardware.
\item Designed and deployed scalable LLM applications, integrating advanced RAG strategies to provide context-aware assistance to engineers.
\item Collaborated with internal and external partners to validate and debug AI software, ensuring robustness and reliability in mission-critical design tools.
\item Optimized machine learning benchmarks and simulation workloads to demonstrate the superior performance of Altera AI products.
